title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 19
statement:
What is the value of the following expression?

\[ \begin{gathered} \small (1901 + 1902 + 1903 + \cdots + 1993) \\ \small {}- (101 + 102 + 103 + \cdots + 193) \end{gathered} \]

solutions.text:
Each number in the first sum is exactly \(1800\) more than the matching number in the second sum, and there are \(93\) such pairs.

So the difference is \(93 \times 1800 = 167{,}400.\)

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: Pair each term with the one below it: \(1901 - 101,\) \(1902 - 102,\) \(\ldots\)
Each of the \(93\) pairs has difference \(1800\)
